title: Pre-validate a turn observation's source basis on the host, so a basis with bidi or control characters loses only that basis, not the whole observation
outcome: Before sending a turn checkpoint, TermAl checks each observation source_basis text for the characters Engram refuses: C0/C1 controls and the complete Unicode Bidi_Control set, which is U+061C, U+200E, U+200F, U+202A-202E and U+2066-2069. When one is found, TermAl drops only that observation basis and the fields derived from it (observed_at, reported_source_change, and evidence derived from the basis), with a holder-visible line, instead of letting Engram refuse the whole checkpoint. Today the refusal ladder (src/engram_turn_observations.rs:761-813) goes from the full report to observations-only, which still carry the basis, to an empty report, so the turn whole observation and any credit it carries is lost. The character set stays identical to Engram source_basis_text_refused rule (Engram bundle 17 with w-cd81066cecc9). No legacy path.
acceptance: Pre-validate a turn observation's source basis on the host, so a basis with bidi or control characters loses only that basis, not the whole observation is done
